python3 -c "
# Let's inspect obs_0024.png
# On the left: floor lamp shade (very close on the left!), and chair!
# On the right: bottle (foreground), stool (middle ground), right wall!
# Far wall in front!
# Let's find pixel locations of stool legs and chair legs in obs_0024.png!

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0024.png'))

# Stool legs: around col 300-370, rows 320-380
# Find stool legs bottom contact:
# Stool legs are greyish/dark (e.g. [70, 75, 85])
for c in [313, 332, 372, 397]:
    # find bottom row
    for r in range(400, 310, -1):
        if img[r, c, 2] > img[r, c, 0] + 10: # grey-blue
            print(f'Stool leg at c={c}: bottom r={r}, rgb={img[r, c]}')
            break

# Also chair legs: around col 20-110, rows 380-430
for c in [22, 70, 107]:
    for r in range(450, 360, -1):
        if img[r, c, 0] > 70 and img[r, c, 2] < 30:
            print(f'Chair leg at c={c}: bottom r={r}, rgb={img[r, c]}')
            break

# Right wall contact:
for r in range(300, 350):
    # look along wall contact
    pass
